children: INQ Group (formerly Anoto Group) Q2 net sales rose 64% yr/yr, driven by retail and enterprise growth
Operating loss widened and loss per share increased compared with Q2 2025
Company completed name change to INQ Group AB and launched new education platform subsequent to quarter end
Company expects Filevine and LAMY partnerships to contribute increasing profitability toward end-2026
INQ Group expects to announce further partnership developments in Q3 and Q4
Company aims to convert enterprise pipeline into commercial agreements and deployments during H2 2026 and 2027
ENTERPRISE SALES - Enterprise revenue jumped 83% to SEK4.3 mln, driven partly by deliveries under the Filevine partnership
RETAIL GROWTH - Retail revenue rose 39% to SEK2.3 mln despite a planned inventory wind-down ahead of the LAMY product transition
HIGHER COSTS - Operating expenses rose, widening Q2 operating loss to SEK26.7 mln from SEK21.1 mln
Aug 31 - Swedish investment firm SpectrumOne's Q2 operating loss narrows
